# A book that says how its dates are to be written.
#
# GnuCash keeps this as a book option — `Business` → `Fancy Date Format` →
# `custom`, which File → Properties → Business writes — and its own invoice
# report reads it (`invoice.scm` calls `gnc:options-fancy-date`). A book
# without one falls back to the *application's* date preference, which lives
# in GSettings rather than in the file, so two people printing the same book
# get differently-dated invoices.
#
# `%d %B %Y` rather than something ISO-shaped on purpose: it is unmistakable
# in a rendered page, and it is not what any of the fallbacks would produce.

2026-01-01 open Assets
  type: Asset
  commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
  commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable
  type: Accounts Receivable
  commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
  commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities
  type: Liability
  commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
  commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Accounts Payable
  type: Accounts Payable
  commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
  commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
  type: Expense
  commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
  commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Office Supplies
  type: Expense
  commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
  commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
  type: Income
  commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
  commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
  type: Income
  commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
  commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

company
  name: "Date Format Co."
  date_format: "%d %B %Y"

customer "C-DATE"
  name: "Date Format Customer"
  currency: CAD

invoice "INV-DATE-001"
  customer_id: "C-DATE"
  currency: CAD
  date_opened: 2026-03-09
  entry:
    date: 2026-03-09
    description: "Consulting"
    action: "Hours"
    account: "Income:Sales"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
    tax_included: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-03-09
    due: 2026-04-09
    ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
    memo: "Invoice INV-DATE-001"
    accumulate: true

# A bill as well as an invoice, because `print-bill` reads the same two date
# settings and names its files the same way — and a fix applied to one of two
# near-identical call sites is the kind that comes back.
vendor "V-DATE"
  name: "Date Format Supply"
  currency: CAD

bill "BILL-DATE-001"
  vendor_id: "V-DATE"
  currency: CAD
  date_opened: 2026-03-09
  entry:
    date: 2026-03-09
    description: "Paper"
    action: "Material"
    account: "Expenses:Office Supplies"
    quantity: 1
    price: 40
    taxable: false
    tax_included: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-03-09
    due: 2026-04-09
    ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable"
    memo: "Bill BILL-DATE-001"
    accumulate: true
